technique_name: Tell me about the African savanna elephant.
description: The African savanna elephant is the largest land animal in the world, and is one of the most iconic African species.It is characterized by its large ears, a long trunk, and awe-inspiring tusks. Savanna elephants can weigh up to 7 tons, and can grow up to 10 feet tall. They live in the grasslands and woodlands of sub-Saharan Africa, and are mainly herbivores that feed on grass, foliage, fruits, and bark.
